description: The line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny,” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) over six training epochs for five different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper tiny model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” is linear and spans from 25 to 70, with major grid lines at intervals of 5. Five distinct lines are plotted: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (solid dark gray line with circle markers) starts at approximately 69 at epoch 0 and declines steadily to about 32 by epoch 6; “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (solid dark gray line with square markers) begins near 60, drops to around 51 by epoch 1, then gradually decreases to approximately 36 by epoch 6; “tiny int4” (dashed dark gray line with circle markers) starts at 69, falls to 50 by epoch 1, and continues to decline to about 40 by epoch 6; “tiny int8” (dashed dark gray line with square markers) begins at 60, drops to 47 by epoch 1, and trends downward to roughly 37 by epoch 6; and “tiny full” (dotted dark gray line with triangle markers) starts at 29, dips slightly to 27 by epoch 1, then remains relatively flat around 24–26 through epoch 6, showing the lowest WER across all configurations.
